Team,

Attached is the first draft of the Q4 trajectory briefing I plan to share with the broader company next week and the comms draft for the org/role changes we discussed last month. Core asks: quick read for tone, one-line edits for clarity, and any red flags on timing.

High-level:

- Timing: leadership readout (internal) on Nov 9; all-hands announcement targeted Nov 15 if we sign off.

Attachments: Q4_trajectory_brief_v1.docx (draft narrative) and org_chart_v2.png (proposed boxes).
